learnings: Media flags accept a JOB ID, not just a local path — skip uploads entirely by referencing a previous job.
`higgsfield upload create` failed on a 2.6MB PNG from this shell; job-id referencing is the reliable path.
`higgsfield generate wait` hangs; poll with `higgsfield generate list --size N` instead.
Passing a full frame as image_reference copies composition, not just identity. soul-id is the correct character-lock mechanism.
